categories.name: Product catalogues
categories.long_name: Commercial / product photography catalogues — 6 frames per pass
categories.description: One product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers, each owning a different camera angle, set and lighting scheme. Each writer feeds its own image-gen node, which also receives the original product reference so geometry, colourway and label typography stay locked. All six frames land in one download node.

categories.name: Editorial frames
categories.long_name: Editorial / cinematic male + female lead frames
categories.description: A cast reference pair drives a setting-locked editorial frame set. Register, time of day and weather are parameterised per file, so the same location yields distinct cinematic treatments without re-briefing the shoot.

categories.name: Character sheets
categories.long_name: Moodboard concept → multi-angle character turnaround sheets
categories.description: A moodboard seed is scraped and distilled into a character concept, then rendered as a multi-angle turnaround sheet. Medium and era are fixed per file so the whole sheet shares one illustration language.

categories.name: Relight composites
categories.description: Subject is cut from its plate, dropped onto a destination background, then relit to match the new environment's key treatment. The relight pass is what separates this from a naive cutout composite.

categories.name: Poster / social
categories.long_name: Poster, social post and thumbnail graphics — 3 ratios
categories.description: Exact copy deck plus brand asset render into a graphic layout across three aspect ratios in one pass, so a single design language ships to poster, feed and thumbnail slots simultaneously.

categories.name: Reshoot director
categories.description: Source clip is analysed factually — runtime, wardrobe, action beats, existing camera treatment — then re-blocked into a multi-shot camera plan with contiguous timecodes. The reshoot grammar and grade are fixed per file.

categories.name: 30s from 3x10s
categories.description: A narrative is split into three ten-second segments, each generated independently with its own beat brief, then concatenated into a single thirty-second cut. Genre, subject, setting and tone are parameterised per file.

categories.name: Brand campaign ads
categories.long_name: Marketing-studio style commercial brand campaign ads
categories.description: Ad format, vertical and audience persona combine into a studio-style campaign spot. The brief stage writes to the persona, not to the product, which is what makes the output read as an ad rather than a product demo.

categories.name: Viral short-form
categories.description: Trend format, topic, structure and angle drive a short-form vertical cut. Files ending -hook-first-frame seed video-gen from a designed first frame; files ending -text-reveal add a lyria-3 audio bed.

categories.name: Omni image systems
categories.long_name: Omni image systems — 500 named multi-stage image programmes
categories.description: Five hundred named image systems, each a deep multi-stage programme — catalogue grids, ad variant gauntlets, trend radars — built with substantially larger node graphs than the A-E catalogue shapes.

categories.name: Product image systems
categories.description: Two hundred and ten production image systems — angle-lock catalogues, marketplace spec compliance packs, fidelity QC loops — generated from the IMAGE_WORKFLOWS library document.

categories.name: Video director systems
categories.description: Eight hundred and fifty video systems — camera-language transfer, continuity rigs, multi-pass direction — generated from the VIDEO_WORKFLOWS library document. These carry the densest edge counts in the catalogue.

categories.name: Viral Omniflash systems
categories.description: Five hundred short-form viral systems — thread-to-video recaps, detail hallucination upscale pipelines, platform-native reveal formats — generated from the VIRAL_OMNIFLASH_WORKFLOWS library document.

categories.name: Image concept packs
categories.long_name: Image concept packs — 100 hand-named campaign concepts
categories.description: One hundred hand-named campaign concepts — trade show loops, kinetic key art, single-take developing shots — each a self-contained concept pack rather than a parametric variant.
